question: What alternate alleles are observed at position 16051453 on chromosome 22?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT alt FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos = 16051453;

question: What is the European allele frequency of the G>A variant at chr22:23000030?
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, ref, alt, eur_af FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos = 23000030 AND ref = 'G' AND alt = 'A';

question: Give the alternate allele count and total allele number for the variant at 22:16050115.
sql: SELECT ac, an FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos = 16050115;

question: How many variants are there between 23,000,000 and 23,100,000 on chr22?
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, ref, alt, af FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos BETWEEN 23000000 AND 23100000 ORDER BY pos;

question: List the indels between positions 23,000,000 and 23,005,000 on chromosome 22.
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, ref, alt, variant_type FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos BETWEEN 23000000 AND 23005000 ORDER BY pos;

question: How many structural variants overlap the interval 22:23,000,000-23,100,000?
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, end_pos, ref, alt, variant_type FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos BETWEEN 22000000 AND 23100000;

question: How many SNPs are on chr22 between 30 Mb and 31 Mb?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos BETWEEN 30000000 AND 31000000 AND variant_type = 'SNP';

question: How many distinct positions on chromosome 22 have at least one variant?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pos) FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22';

question: What is the average global allele frequency of indels?
sql: SELECT AVG(af) FROM variants WHERE variant_type = 'INDEL';

question: How many structural variants are there of each SV type?
sql: SELECT sv_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM variants WHERE variant_type = 'SV' GROUP BY sv_type ORDER BY n DESC;

question: What fraction of SNPs are transitions?
sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN variant_type = 'SNP' AND ref <> alt THEN 1 END) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM variants;

question: How many variants have a total read depth above 30,000?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM variants WHERE dp > 30000;

question: How many singletons are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE ac = 1;

question: How many common variants are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE af >= 0.05;

question: How many variants have an alternate allele frequency above 99%?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE af > 0.99;

question: How many rare variants are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE af < 0.01;

question: How many low-frequency variants are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE af < 0.05;

question: How many variants are private to African populations?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE afr_af > 0 AND amr_af = 0 AND eas_af = 0 AND eur_af = 0 AND sas_af = 0;

question: How many variants are found only in Europeans?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE eur_af > 0 AND afr_af = 0 AND amr_af = 0 AND eas_af = 0 AND sas_af = 0;

question: Which 3 variants are most strongly enriched in East Asians relative to Europeans?
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, ref, alt, eas_af, eur_af FROM variants WHERE eas_af - eur_af >= 0.4 ORDER BY eas_af - eur_af DESC LIMIT 3;

question: How many variants are common in Africans (frequency at least 5%) but absent from Europeans?
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, ref, alt, afr_af FROM variants WHERE afr_af >= 0.05 AND eur_af = 0 ORDER BY afr_af DESC;

question: What is the mean South Asian allele frequency among variants absent in East Asians?
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, ref, alt, sas_af FROM variants WHERE sas_af > 0 AND afr_af = 0 AND amr_af = 0 AND eas_af = 0 AND eur_af = 0;

question: How many variants are polymorphic in all five continental populations?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE afr_af > 0 AND amr_af > 0 AND eas_af > 0 AND eur_af > 0 AND sas_af > 0;

question: Among variants with frequency above 50% in Africans, what proportion also exceed 50% in Europeans?
sql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN afr_af > 0.5 THEN 1 END) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE afr_af > 0.5;

question: How many variants differ in frequency by more than 0.5 between Africans and Europeans, in either direction?
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, ref, alt, afr_af, eur_af FROM variants WHERE afr_af - eur_af > 0.5 OR afr_af - eur_af < -0.5 ORDER BY afr_af - eur_af DESC;

question: What is the longest deletion structural variant? Give its start, end and length.
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, end_pos, end_pos - pos + 1 AS length_bp FROM variants WHERE variant_type = 'SV' AND sv_type = 'DEL' ORDER BY length_bp DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many Alu insertions are there?
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, ref, alt, af FROM variants WHERE variant_type = 'SV' AND sv_type = 'ALU' ORDER BY af DESC;

question: How many structural variants are longer than 100 kb?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM variants WHERE variant_type = 'SV' AND end_pos - pos + 1 > 100000;

question: How many copy-number variant alleles have a frequency above 1%?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE sv_type = 'CNV' AND af > 0.01;

question: How many insertions are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE variant_type = 'INS';

question: What is the length in bases of the longest insertion?
sql: SELECT MAX(length(alt) - length(ref)) AS length_bp FROM variants WHERE variant_type = 'INS';

question: How many deletions of 10 or more bases are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE variant_type = 'INDEL' AND length(ref) - length(alt) >= 10;

question: How many variants lie within the exome capture target?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos BETWEEN 1000000 AND 2000000;

question: For how many SNPs is the high-confidence ancestral allele the alternate allele?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND pos = 16050075 AND info->>'AA' = alt;

question: How many variant rows come from multi-allelic sites?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE is_multiallelic = TRUE;

question: Which 1-Mb window of chr22 contains the most singletons? Give the window start position and the count.
sql: SELECT chrom, pos, ref, alt, COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE chrom = '22' AND is_multiallelic = FALSE GROUP BY chrom, pos, ref, alt ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For each variant type, what percentage of its variants are rare? Round to one decimal place.
sql: SELECT variant_type, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(ac) OVER (), 1) AS rare_percentage FROM variants GROUP BY variant_type, ac ORDER BY rare_percentage DESC;

question: How many pathogenic or likely pathogenic ClinVar variants are there on chromosome 22?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinvar WHERE significance_class IN ('pathogenic', 'likely_pathogenic');

question: Which gene has the most pathogenic ClinVar variants, and how many does it have?
sql: SELECT c.gene, COUNT(*) FROM clinvar c WHERE clinical_significance = 'Pathogenic' GROUP BY c.gene ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many CHEK2 variants of uncertain significance are in ClinVar?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinvar WHERE gene = 'CHEK2' AND significance_class = 'uncertain';

question: What is the ClinVar clinical significance of rs4680?
sql: SELECT clinical_significance FROM clinvar WHERE rsid = 'rs4680';

question: How many ClinVar variants were reviewed by an expert panel or have a practice guideline?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinvar WHERE review_stars >= 3 OR significance_class = 'pathogenic';

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinvar WHERE gene = 'COMT' AND consequence = 'missense_variant';

question: How many different genes on chromosome 22 have at least one ClinVar variant?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gene) FROM clinvar WHERE chrom = '22';

question: How many ClinVar variants have conflicting classifications?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinvar WHERE review_stars = 1;

question: How many ClinVar variants are associated with schizophrenia?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clinvar WHERE conditions ILIKE '%schizophrenia%';

question: What are the African and European allele frequencies of the APOL1 risk variant rs73885319?
sql: SELECT afr_af, eur_af FROM variants WHERE rsid = 'rs73885319';

question: How many pathogenic ClinVar variants are also observed in the 1000 Genomes data?
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM clinvar c JOIN variants v ON v.chrom = c.chrom AND v.pos = c.pos AND v.ref = c.ref AND v.alt = c.alt WHERE c.is_pathogenic AND v.is_multiallelic;

question: Which pathogenic ClinVar variants are more than 1 percentage point more frequent in Africans than in Europeans?
sql: SELECT c.gene, c.pos, c.ref, c.alt, c.clinical_significance, v.afr_af, v.eur_af FROM clinvar c JOIN variants v ON v.chrom = c.chrom AND v.pos = c.pos AND v.ref = c.ref AND v.alt = c.alt WHERE c.is_pathogenic AND v.afr_af - v.eur_af > 0.01;

question: Among APOL1 variants in ClinVar that also appear in 1000 Genomes, what is the highest African allele frequency?
sql: SELECT v.chrom, v.pos, v.ref, v.alt, v.afr_af FROM clinvar c JOIN variants v ON v.chrom = c.chrom AND v.pos = c.pos AND v.ref = c.ref AND v.alt = c.alt WHERE c.gene = 'APOL1' AND v.afr_af > 0;

question: Of the ClinVar variants that are present in 1000 Genomes, what fraction are rare?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants WHERE af < 0.01;

question: List every 1000 Genomes variant located within the APOL1 gene, including variants that are not in ClinVar.
sql: SELECT v.chrom, v.pos, v.ref, v.alt FROM variants v WHERE v.chrom = '22' AND v.pos BETWEEN 1000000 AND 2000000 AND v.is_multiallelic = TRUE;

question: What is the gnomAD allele frequency of rs4680?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.chrom, T1.pos, T1.ref, T1.alt, T2.allele_frequency AS gnomAD_frequency FROM variants AS T1 INNER JOIN gnomad_variants AS T2 ON T1.chrom = T2.chrom AND T1.pos = T2.pos AND T1.ref = T2.ref AND T1.alt = T2.alt;

sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.gene FROM clinvar AS T1 INNER JOIN variants AS T2 ON T1.chrom = T2.chrom AND T1.pos = T2.pos AND T1.ref = T2.ref AND T1.alt = T2.alt WHERE T1.chrom = '22' ORDER BY T2.dp DESC LIMIT 10;
